title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten named stops on the Texas Avenue corridor, a principal route linking Texas A&M University with College Station destinations.

cards.title: Visitor Center: pick up local orientation
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 1207 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Stop in for maps and local guidance before heading along Texas Avenue; the center sits next to City Hall and across from Texas A&M.
cards.short_summary: A practical starting point for paper maps and visitor information.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station states its Visitor Center is at 1207 Texas Avenue South, next to City Hall and across the street from Texas A&M University.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–2 p.m.

cards.title: City Hall: see the civic center of the corridor
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 1101 Texas Ave
cards.notes: Use City Hall as a recognizable waypoint on Texas Avenue, then continue north toward campus or south toward the corridor’s shops and restaurants.
cards.short_summary: College Station’s municipal headquarters anchors the campus-facing stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists City Hall at 1101 Texas Avenue in College Station.
cards.source_title: Traveling In, Around & Beyond Aggieland | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Exterior civic landmark; check City of College Station services for building-entry details.

cards.title: Texas A&M: connect into the campus walk
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — campus frontage opposite Visitor Center
cards.notes: Use the Texas Avenue frontage to transition from College Station’s main corridor into a campus walk, then choose a museum, garden, or athletic landmark.
cards.short_summary: The university is the major campus-side destination along this route.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station identifies Texas A&M University as a College Station attraction and notes campus galleries, museums, the Bonfire Memorial, gardens, tours, and Kyle Field.
cards.access_notes: Campus access and event availability vary by building and date.

cards.title: And Sew On: personalize a small item
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 719 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Bring a tote, gift, or apparel idea and ask about the shop’s embroidery, appliqué, heat-pressing, or vinyl-lettering services before placing an order.
cards.short_summary: A corridor stop centered on customized gifts and apparel.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists And Sew On at 719 Texas Avenue South and describes embroidery, appliqué, heat pressing, and vinyl lettering services.
cards.source_title: And Sew On | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 10 a.m.–6 p.m.; Saturday 10 a.m.–3 p.m.; closed Sunday.

cards.title: Lupe Tortilla: choose a Tex-Mex meal
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 813 Texas Ave
cards.notes: Plan a meal stop around the listed fajitas, tacos, enchiladas, and fresh-made tortillas; confirm seating and current menu directly with the restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A Texas Avenue restaurant serving a documented Tex-Mex menu.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Lupe Tortilla at 813 Texas Avenue and describes its Tex-Mex menu as including fajitas, tacos, enchiladas, and fresh-made tortillas.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Sunday–Thursday 11 a.m.–9 p.m.; Friday–Saturday 11 a.m.–10 p.m.

cards.title: Freebirds: build a burrito or bowl
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2050 S Texas Ave
cards.notes: Use the customization menu to assemble a burrito, bowl, salad, taco, nachos, or quesadilla; check current ingredients and dietary options before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A quick-service stop with several documented buildable meal formats.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Freebirds at 2050 South Texas Avenue and says customers can choose burritos, nachos, salads, bowls, tacos, or quesadillas.
cards.source_title: Freebirds - Texas Ave. | Visit College Station

cards.title: DSW: browse shoes by occasion
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2026 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Browse the footwear assortment for a specific need—casual, formal, athletic, or dress—then verify in-store sizes and current inventory before buying.
cards.short_summary: A Texas Avenue retail stop focused on footwear categories.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists DSW at 2026 Texas Avenue South and describes footwear for men, women, and children across casual, formal, athletic, and dress uses.
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Saturday 10 a.m.–8 p.m.; Sunday 11 a.m.–7 p.m.

cards.title: Juicing to be Gooden Fit: order juice or a wellness shot
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 2414 Texas Ave S, Suite B
cards.notes: Choose from the shop’s documented juices and wellness shots for a daytime stop; confirm the current menu and ingredients at the counter before ordering.
cards.short_summary: A juice-bar stop on the south Texas Avenue stretch.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Juicing to be Gooden Fit at 2414 Texas Avenue South, Suite B, and describes juices and wellness shots.
cards.source_title: Juicing to be Gooden Fit | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Listed hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–7 p.m.; Saturday 7 a.m.–4 p.m.; Sunday noon–5 p.m.

cards.title: Mojo Tortilla Co.: try tortillas made on-site
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — 3125 Texas Ave S
cards.notes: Make this a meal stop for tortillas prepared on-site and build-your-own tacos; use the listed address to continue along the south Texas Avenue corridor.
cards.short_summary: A south-corridor Tex-Mex stop with on-site tortilla preparation.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station lists Mojo Tortilla Co. at 3125 Texas Avenue South and states that it makes handcrafted tortillas fresh on-site and offers build-your-own tacos.
cards.source_title: Mojo Tortilla Co. | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: The listing reports the restaurant as open 24/7; confirm before a late visit.

cards.title: Post Oak Mall: extend the corridor to indoor shopping
cards.subtitle: Texas Avenue corridor — beside Texas Ave at 1500 Harvey Rd
cards.notes: Use the mall as an indoor retail destination immediately off the Texas Avenue corridor; identify a specific store or service before you go and confirm its hours.
cards.short_summary: A named shopping center beside the Texas Avenue route.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit College Station identifies Post Oak Mall as a College Station destination and notes that major routes including Texas Avenue connect major destinations across the city.
cards.source_title: Traveling In, Around & Beyond Aggieland | Visit College Station
cards.access_notes: Individual tenant hours and access vary.
